name: agentic-mode
description: Optional Claude Code plugins for the agentic-mode methodology: the doc-contract bootstrapper, five harness-neutral collaboration playbooks (commit messages, two-axis review, review response, document linting, OKF doc style), the fable5 commander-mode operating discipline, the commander dispatch-and-score loop, the idea-to-spec spec synthesizer that turns rough idea material into an executable development SPEC, the pstack pack of 36 third-party engineering skills ported under MIT, and the team-kit four-role worker kit (observer/coder/reviewer/fortify) with its team-rules canon, verify-gate hook scripts, and state contract. Install only the ones your team wants.

plugins.name: agentic-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap or adopt the agentic-mode documentation pipeline in any repo — a layered, ID-joined, harness-neutral set of collaboration docs (AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS, USER_GUIDE/API_REFERENCE, VALIDATION, WORKFLOW) plus a config-driven checker and CI gate. Self-contained: vendors the RUNBOOK, doctrine, templates, and checker.

plugins.name: gcm
plugins.description: Write commit messages in a Conventional-Commits variant: a type table with explicit build/ci/chore adjudications, an optional ticket appended between type and colon (on demand, not mandatory), and scope rules — always deferring to a repo's local commit-msg hook.

plugins.name: two-axis-review
plugins.description: Dual-axis code review that audits Standards (is it written right) and Spec (does it meet the ticket) on independent parallel axes that never merge or cross-rank — deferring to a repo's local review canon for the Standards checklist and adding the ticket-acceptance axis.

plugins.name: review-response
plugins.description: Discipline for responding to code-review feedback: verify each comment against the codebase before implementing, no sycophantic openers, and always push back with evidence — treating the ticket description itself as an external signal to be checked.

plugins.name: doc-linter
plugins.description: Lint agent-facing documents (SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, HANDOFF.md, README, runbooks, prompts) for ambiguity, terminology drift, passive voice, hedge words, stacked negations, and structure problems, using rules adapted from ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — a severity-ordered report with verbatim quotes and ready-to-paste rewrites. Harness-neutral: the mechanical pass ships as a stdlib script (doc_lint.py) and the judgment rules stay in markdown; writes only to a document you point it at, in fix mode, after you accept the rewrites.

plugins.name: fable5
plugins.description: Commander-mode operating discipline: the main model stays an advisor/dispatcher that converses, decides, delegates, and integrates while subagents do the heavy execution — plus the founding prompt for spending one strong-model session to externalize judgment into rule files a weaker model can follow long-term. Harness-specific and self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync).

plugins.name: commander
plugins.description: Stand up a runnable dispatch-and-score loop inside a repo: a single-file constitution that turns any model into a commander who dispatches tasks to subagents, scores the output on a three-layer pyramid (mechanical gate → report contract → fresh-context judge), attributes every failure to the layer that let it through, and patches the harness so the next run is easier. Ships the constitution, the report protocol, the task template, a dispatch script and an L1 scorer, plus the run-ledger scaffold. Self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync).

plugins.name: idea-to-spec
plugins.description: Turn rough idea material — a draft note, an HTML mock, screenshots, pasted text — into a development SPEC that a human and a coding agent can both execute from: one batch interview, a small/medium/large triage that sets the spec's depth, and a 12-section template with quantified success metrics, product invariants, vertical slices, and an acceptance contract naming the cheapest layer able to judge each row. Covers a brand-new project and a new feature inside an existing repo. Self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync).

plugins.name: okf-doc-style
plugins.description: Author or convert a knowledge corpus into Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2: a 9-step runbook covering bundle layout, frontmatter families (provenance, trust, lifecycle, attested computation), actor and path conventions, and index/log files, plus a mechanical conformance pass (K1–K8) shipped as stdlib scripts (okf_lint.py + okf_parse.py). Reads and writes markdown documents only; executes nothing.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Thirty-six portable engineering skills ported from the pstack collection under MIT: 24 named principles that steer design and execution decisions, plus the twelve workflow skills architect, arena, benchmark-checklist, blast-radius, create-verification-skill, figure-it-out, interrogate, maintain-verification-skill, tdd, technical-writing, typescript-best-practices, and unslop. Each skill is self-contained and loads on demand. Self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync); see the plugin's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICE.md for the source and license.

plugins.name: team-kit
plugins.description: A four-role worker kit for dispatch-style teamwork: observer (pure dispatcher), coder (implementation gated by a SubagentStop verify hook), reviewer (dual-axis read-only review), and fortify (security pre-check), plus the team-rules canon, hook scripts, and the runtime state contract in STATE-CONTRACT.md. 四角色協作 kit：observer 純派工、coder 實作＋verify 停止閘門、reviewer 兩軸唯讀審查、fortify 安全預檢，附 team-rules 規範、hook 腳本與狀態面契約（STATE-CONTRACT.md）。Self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync).
